name: bima-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya insurance intelligence — NHIF-era (now SHA/SHIF) coverage figures, parametric crop risk, microinsurance comparison. Demo data.
author: Gabriel Mahia

tools.name: kenya_insurance_products
tools.description: Browse sample insurance products in Kenya by product type, with provider, cover and indicative price. Use when someone asks what kinds of insurance exist. product_type filters by matching text; no match returns an empty list. Returns status, the products, the count and a note. SYNTHETIC data labelled DEMO: verify at ira.go.ke before advising anyone. Read-only.

tools.name: nhif_coverage_query
tools.description: DEPRECATED NAME and OUTDATED FIGURES: NHIF was replaced by SHA and SHIF in October 2024. Use when a client still asks about hospital rebates by facility level; it returns illustrative per-day NHIF-era benefit amounts by level (level_2 to level_6) and procedure type, which do NOT describe SHA's current benefit packages. An unrecognised level is treated as level_4 and tier_applied says so. Returns the tier, procedure, the illustrative benefit or 'Not covered at this tier', coverage notes and a source label saying the figures are synthetic and NHIF-era. Check sha.go.ke for real coverage. Read-only.

tools.name: premium_estimate
tools.description: Estimate a monthly and annual insurance premium for a type of cover from age, monthly income, county, acreage and crop, with an affordability ratio against income. Use when someone asks what cover might cost. A simple DEMO formula on SYNTHETIC rates: real premiums come from insurers' quotes. Returns the estimated monthly and annual premium, the affordability ratio and notes. Read-only.

tools.name: parametric_crop_risk
tools.description: Estimate drought risk and an illustrative parametric insurance premium and payout for a crop in a county, from a small county drought-frequency table and a crop multiplier. Use when exploring index insurance for farmers. A county or crop not in the table gets a default (30% drought frequency, multiplier 1.0) and county_in_table and crop_in_table say so. The table is hand-written and not verified against NDMA data. Returns a risk score and category, the drought frequency, a premium, a payout trigger and expected payout. DEMO only. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_microinsurance
tools.description: List sample microinsurance products affordable within a monthly budget for a target group (farmers, boda riders, traders and others). Use when someone asks which cover fits their budget. target_group filters by matching text and max_monthly_budget_kes by price; no match returns an empty list with the priority risks. Returns the target group, budget, the affordable products and priority risks. SYNTHETIC products for illustration: verify at ira.go.ke. Read-only.

tools.name: community_pool_calculator
tools.description: Model a community insurance pool: monthly and annual pool size, and how many claims a coverage goal could support, from group size and monthly contribution. Use when a chama or group wants to self-insure. coverage_goal is only echoed back for context. A simple DEMO calculation with no claims-risk modelling and no regulatory approval: pooling risk is regulated insurance business in Kenya, so speak to the Insurance Regulatory Authority. Returns the pool economics and notes. Read-only.
